title: Concentration of Stationary Measures onto Large Scales in the Fast-Advection Limit of the Stochastically Forced Two-Dimensional Navier-Stokes Equations
summary: We investigate the fast-advection limit ($\varepsilon \to 0$) of the stochastically forced two-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations on the torus. Numerical simulations are performed at resolution $N = 128$ for four different forcing shells on both the square torus and a thin torus, with the advection parameter $\varepsilon$ varied over approximately one decade.
